//engines: pnpm >=10 is load-bearing, not aspirational. The dompurify security override lives ONLY in pnpm-workspace.yaml now, and pnpm 9 does not read overrides from there - it read them from a `pnpm` field here, which pnpm 10 dropped. So installing this workspace with pnpm 9 would silently resolve dompurify below its advisory floor (measured: 3.4.8). Lower this floor only by restoring that field alongside the workspace one.
